chunks: When the sentence will have been passed upon them for their wickedness, they will not be able to say a word.

key_terms.لَا يَنْطِقُونَ: They will not speak or be able to say a word
key_terms.وَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ: The execution of the divine decree or sentence

ai.seo_question: Why will disbelievers be unable to speak on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of 'Habs al-Lisan' (restraint of speech) as a direct consequence of their internal denial, where the weight of their own sins silences them before Allah. It underscores the justice of God, where the disbelievers are prevented from speaking not merely by divine decree, but by the natural outcome of their own falsehoods, rendering their excuses futile.
